title.en: Pregnancy nutrition and U.S. grocery guide

summary.zh-Hant: 營養素優先順序、魚類汞分級、Trader Joe's / Whole Foods 採買清單、食安三級。
summary.en: Nutrient priorities, fish mercury tiers, Trader Joe's and Whole Foods shopping lists, food-safety tiers.

title.zh-Hant: 懷孕期間運動指南（第一孕期）

summary.zh-Hant: 運動模式延續、與教練溝通、強度判斷、重量上限與硬舉、骨盆底肌訓練、停止運動警訊。
summary.en: Keeping your routine, talking to your trainer, judging intensity, lifting limits, pelvic floor training, warning signs to stop.

title.zh-Hant: 孕早期快結束了：先把這 4 件事排進行事曆
title.en: The first trimester is almost over: put these 4 things on your calendar

summary.zh-Hant: 流感疫苗任何孕期都能打；約第 20 週照解剖超音波；24–28 週驗妊娠糖尿病；27–36 週打百日咳疫苗。每一件都多問一句：為什麼是這個時間？
summary.en: Flu shot any trimester; anatomy ultrasound around week 20; gestational diabetes screening in weeks 24–28; Tdap in weeks 27–36. For each: why this timing?

q.zh-Hant: 媽媽以前得過流感或打過疫苗，懷孕為什麼還要再打？
q.en: If mom has had flu or a flu shot before, why get one in pregnancy?

a.zh-Hant: 病毒每年在變、舊保護會下降；懷孕時比較容易重症；寶寶滿 6 個月前不能打，要靠媽媽傳給他的抗體。
a.en: Viruses change and old protection fades; pregnancy makes severe flu more likely; and the baby can't be vaccinated until 6 months, so it relies on antibodies from mom.

q.zh-Hant: 百日咳疫苗為什麼建議在 27–36 週的前段打？
q.en: Why is Tdap best given early in weeks 27–36?

a.zh-Hant: 抗體約 2 週到高峰，傳給寶寶還需要時間，而媽媽的抗體會隨時間下降；早一點打，生產時抗體還高、也來得及傳給寶寶。
a.en: Antibodies peak about 2 weeks after the shot, transfer takes time, and mom's levels fall; earlier in the window keeps levels high at birth with time to reach the baby.

q.zh-Hant: 第 20 週左右的超音波主要看什麼？能抓到所有問題嗎？
q.en: What does the week-20 ultrasound look at, and does it catch everything?

a.zh-Hant: 看心臟、腎臟、四肢等構造，但無法排除所有異常；MedlinePlus 概估可偵測約半數，實際依異常種類與檢查條件而異。
a.en: The heart, kidneys, limbs and other anatomy. Not every anomaly can be ruled out: MedlinePlus broadly estimates half can be detected, with rates varying by anomaly and scan conditions.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼妊娠糖尿病篩檢排在 24–28 週？
q.en: Why is gestational diabetes screening done in weeks 24–28?

a.zh-Hant: 懷孕荷爾蒙造成的胰島素阻抗越來越明顯，妊娠糖尿病通常在第 24 週左右才出現。
a.en: Insulin resistance from pregnancy hormones builds up, and gestational diabetes usually appears around week 24.

q.zh-Hant: Tdap 為什麼每一胎都要打？
q.en: Why is Tdap given in every pregnancy?

a.zh-Hant: 它的作用是讓媽媽在出生前把抗體傳給這一個寶寶，每個寶寶都需要自己那一次。
a.en: Its job is to pass antibodies to this particular baby before birth, and each baby needs its own transfer.

title.zh-Hant: 產檢也能請有薪假：紐約多給你 20 小時，不用動到病假
title.en: Prenatal appointments come with paid time off in New York: 20 hours, on top of sick leave

summary.zh-Hant: 紐約州私部門員工每 52 週有 20 小時有薪產檢假，按小時請、不必說明檢查內容，但只有孕婦本人能用。寶寶出生後，接手的是父母都能請的有薪家庭假。
summary.en: Private-sector workers in New York get 20 hours of Paid Prenatal Leave per 52 weeks, usable by the hour with no need to say what the visit is, but only by the pregnant person. After the birth, Paid Family Leave takes over for both parents.

q.zh-Hant: 已經有病假了，為什麼產檢還要特地用產檢假？
q.en: You have sick leave, so why use Paid Prenatal Leave for appointments?

a.zh-Hant: 因為那 20 小時是額外的，不從病假扣；先用它，病假就能留給真的生病。雇主也不能強迫你改用別的假。
a.en: The 20 hours are extra and don't come out of sick leave, so using them first saves sick days for illness. Your employer can't make you use another type instead.

q.zh-Hant: 伴侶陪產檢可以用這 20 小時嗎？
q.en: Can a partner use the 20 hours to come to appointments?

a.zh-Hant: 不行，只有懷孕的人本人能用。伴侶的假是出生後的有薪家庭假。
a.en: No, only the pregnant person can. The partner's leave is Paid Family Leave after the birth.

q.zh-Hant: 請產檢假時，要告訴雇主是什麼檢查嗎？
q.en: Do you have to tell your employer what the appointment is for?

a.zh-Hant: 不用。雇主不能問健康資訊或看診原因，也不能要求病歷。
a.en: No. Your employer can't ask for health information or the reason, or require medical records.

q.zh-Hant: 有薪家庭假可以在生產前開始嗎？要多早通知？
q.en: Can Paid Family Leave start before the birth, and how much notice is needed?

a.zh-Hant: 不行，出生後才能開始，並要在 12 個月內請完；可預見時至少 30 天前通知雇主。
a.en: No. It starts only after the birth and must be used within 12 months; give at least 30 days' notice when foreseeable.

q.zh-Hant: 產檢假沒用完會怎樣？
q.en: What happens to unused prenatal leave hours?

a.zh-Hant: 不會帶到下一期，也不會折現，而且不能用在產後照護。52 週從第一次使用開始算。
a.en: They don't roll over or get paid out, and they can't be used for care after pregnancy. The 52 weeks start at first use.

title.zh-Hant: 憂鬱不一定等到產後：孕期就能預防，諮商讓風險少近 4 成
title.en: Depression doesn't wait for the birth: it can be prevented in pregnancy, and counseling cuts the risk by about 40%

summary.zh-Hant: 圍產期憂鬱從懷孕期間就可能開始，伴侶也會遇到。風險較高的人在孕期接受 CBT 或 IPT 諮商，發生風險約低 4 成；產檢時主動提心情，並把紐約可用的專線存起來。
summary.en: Perinatal depression can start in pregnancy, and partners can be affected too. For people at higher risk, CBT or IPT counseling lowers the risk by about 40%. Bring up your mood at prenatal visits and save the hotlines available in New York.

q.zh-Hant: 圍產期憂鬱涵蓋哪一段時間？
q.en: What time span does perinatal depression cover?

a.zh-Hant: 懷孕期間到產後 1 年。孕期的憂鬱沒治療，可能變重並延續到產後。
a.en: Pregnancy through 1 year after birth. Untreated depression in pregnancy can worsen and continue after the birth.

q.zh-Hant: 還沒有憂鬱，為什麼高風險的人現在就該談諮商？
q.en: If you're not depressed yet, why should a higher-risk person talk about counseling now?

a.zh-Hant: 因為諮商是「預防」：17 個試驗、3,094 人的合併結果，接受諮商的人發生圍產期憂鬱的風險比是 0.61，約低 4 成。
a.en: Because counseling is prevention: pooling 17 trials with 3,094 people, counseling groups had a risk ratio of 0.61, about 40% lower risk of perinatal depression.

q.zh-Hant: USPSTF 舉了哪些「風險較高」的例子？
q.en: What examples of "higher risk" does the USPSTF give?

a.zh-Hant: 曾有憂鬱病史、目前有尚未達臨床診斷門檻的憂鬱症狀，或低收入、年輕或單親等社經因素。
a.en: A history of depression, current depressive symptoms below a diagnostic threshold, or socioeconomic factors such as low income or young or single parenthood.

q.zh-Hant: 伴侶也會有圍產期情緒問題嗎？
q.en: Can partners have perinatal mood problems too?

a.zh-Hant: 會。紐約州心理衛生廳指出約每 10 位伴侶有 1 位。
a.en: Yes. The NY State Office of Mental Health says about 1 in 10 partners do.

q.zh-Hant: 全國孕產婦心理健康專線怎麼聯絡？
q.en: How do you reach the National Maternal Mental Health Hotline?

a.zh-Hant: 打電話或傳簡訊到 1-833-TLC-MAMA（1-833-852-6262），免費、保密、24 小時，有英語、西班牙語及中文口譯，伴侶也能使用。
a.en: Call or text 1-833-TLC-MAMA (1-833-852-6262): free, confidential, 24/7, with English, Spanish and interpreter support (including Chinese); partners can call too.

title.zh-Hant: 寶寶早就在動了，你只是還感覺不到：第一次胎動多在 16–24 週
title.en: Your baby is already moving, you just can't feel it yet: first movements usually come at 16–24 weeks

summary.zh-Hant: 寶寶從孕早期就開始動，因為活動能幫關節、肌肉和骨骼發育；但要到 16–24 週才感覺得到，第一胎或前壁胎盤可能更晚。24 週還沒感覺就告訴醫護；之後胎動變少，立刻打電話。
summary.en: The baby starts moving early in pregnancy because movement helps build joints, muscles and bones, but you usually feel it only at 16–24 weeks, later with a first baby or an anterior placenta. Tell your provider if there's nothing by 24 weeks; later, call right away if movement drops.

q.zh-Hant: 多數人第一次感覺到胎動是在第幾週？第一胎呢？
q.en: When do most people first feel the baby move? And with a first baby?

a.zh-Hant: 16 到 24 週之間；第一胎可能要過了 20 週。
a.en: Between 16 and 24 weeks; with a first baby, possibly not until after 20 weeks.

q.zh-Hant: 寶寶為什麼需要在子宮裡動？
q.en: Why does the baby need to move in the uterus?

a.zh-Hant: 胎兒本身的活動有助於關節、肌肉和骨骼發育；嚴重、持續的活動受限可能涉及先天性關節攣縮。這和孕早期媽媽感覺不到胎動不同。
a.en: Fetal movement helps develop joints, muscles and bones. Severe, prolonged restriction of movement can be involved in congenital joint contractures; this is different from not feeling kicks early in pregnancy.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼前壁胎盤會讓人比較晚感覺到胎動？
q.en: Why can an anterior placenta delay feeling movement?

a.zh-Hant: 因為胎盤位在子宮和肚皮之間，可能讓第一次胎動較難感覺到。
a.en: Because the placenta sits between the uterus and the belly wall, which may make the first movements harder to feel.

q.zh-Hant: 之後如果胎動變少或模式改變，該怎麼做？
q.en: Later on, what should you do if movement drops or the pattern changes?

a.zh-Hant: 立刻打電話給產科或產房，不要等到隔天，半夜也一樣。不要用家用胎心儀自己聽：聽到心跳不代表寶寶沒事。
a.en: Call your OB or labor and delivery right away, without waiting for the next day, even at night. Don't check with a home doppler: hearing a heartbeat doesn't mean the baby is well.

title.zh-Hant: 寶寶何時能聽見你說話？不同醫學資料相差幾週
title.en: When can your baby hear your voice? Medical sources differ by weeks

summary.zh-Hant: 胎兒約 18 週開始聽見體內的聲音；外界人聲的時程各家略有差異，NHS 指出約 24 週，AAP 則說約 27–29 週。日常說話或唱歌能讓聲音變熟悉，不做也不必內疚。孕期應避開非常大的噪音與低頻震動；耳塞不能完全保護胎兒。
summary.en: Fetuses begin hearing sounds inside the body around week 18. Guidance varies on outside voices: NHS says around week 24, while AAP says around weeks 27–29. Talking or singing can make your voice familiar, but it is optional. Avoid very loud noise and low-frequency rumble during pregnancy; earplugs do not fully protect the fetus.

q.zh-Hant: 寶寶大約幾週開始聽得到你身體裡的聲音？什麼時候聽得到外面的聲音，像你說話？
q.en: Around when does the baby start hearing sounds inside your body? And outside sounds, like your voice?

a.zh-Hant: AAP 說約 18 週聽得到心跳等身體裡的聲音，27 到 29 週左右聽得到外面的聲音，包括你說話。
a.en: AAP says about 18 weeks for body sounds like your heartbeat, and around 27 to 29 weeks for outside sounds, including your voice.

q.zh-Hant: 寶寶出生前聽不懂話，為什麼還值得跟他說話、唱歌？
q.en: The baby can't understand words before birth, so why is talking and singing still worth it?

a.zh-Hant: 不是為了教他，而是讓聲音變熟悉：反覆聽到的聲音寶寶會認得，出生後熟悉的歌、書和你的聲音能安撫他。新生兒研究也看到，子宮裡聽到的語言會影響出生後對母音的反應。
a.en: Not to teach, but to make sounds familiar: babies recognize sounds they hear over and over, and after birth familiar songs, books and your voice can comfort them. A newborn study also found that language heard in the womb shapes how babies respond to vowels after birth.

q.zh-Hant: 在很吵的地方戴耳塞，能保護肚子裡的寶寶嗎？
q.en: Does wearing earplugs in a loud place protect the baby?

a.zh-Hant: 不能完全保護。聲音會穿過身體傳進子宮；CDC 建議孕期就算戴著聽力防護，也避開超過 115 分貝（約電鋸）的地方。
a.en: Not fully. Sound travels through the body into the womb; CDC advises avoiding places louder than 115 dBA (about a chainsaw) during pregnancy, even with hearing protection.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼低頻的轟隆聲、震動要特別避開？
q.en: Why should you especially avoid low-frequency rumble and vibration?

a.zh-Hant: 因為低頻聲音比高頻更容易穿過身體，傳到寶寶那裡。
a.en: Because low-frequency sound travels through the body, and to the baby, more easily than high-frequency sound.

title.zh-Hant: 懷孕可以看牙醫嗎？照 X 光、打麻藥都安全，別拖到產後
title.en: Can you see the dentist while pregnant? X-rays and numbing shots are safe, so don't wait until after the birth

summary.zh-Hant: CDC 與 HRSA 都說牙科治療在懷孕任何階段都安全，包括 X 光、局部麻醉、補牙和根管治療；只有鎮靜、笑氣、全身麻醉和用藥要先問產科醫師。荷爾蒙讓牙齦更容易發炎，產後蛀牙細菌也可能傳給寶寶，所以趁孕期處理。治療牙周病能否降低早產，目前證據還不確定。
summary.en: The CDC and HRSA say dental care is safe at any stage of pregnancy, including X-rays, numbing shots, fillings and root canals; only sedation, nitrous oxide, general anesthesia and medicines need your OB's input first. Hormones make gums more easily inflamed and cavity bacteria can pass to the baby after birth, so get care now. Whether treating gum disease lowers preterm birth is still uncertain.

q.zh-Hant: 懷孕時照牙齒 X 光、打局部麻醉安全嗎？
q.en: Are dental X-rays and numbing shots safe in pregnancy?

a.zh-Hant: 有臨床需要的牙科 X 光和局部麻醉在孕期可以安全進行。ADA 不再建議例行穿鉛衣，但紐約州法律仍要求照牙科 X 光時保護軀幹與甲狀腺（甲狀腺護罩有特定例外）。靜脈鎮靜、笑氣、全身麻醉及用藥須先與產科討論。
a.en: Clinically indicated dental X-rays and local anesthesia are safe during pregnancy. The ADA no longer routinely recommends lead aprons, but New York law still requires torso and thyroid shielding during dental X-rays (with a limited thyroid exception). Discuss IV sedation, nitrous oxide, general anesthesia and medicines with the OB.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼懷孕更容易牙齦發炎？
q.en: Why are gums more likely to get inflamed in pregnancy?

a.zh-Hant: 孕期荷爾蒙會讓牙齦對牙菌斑細菌的反應變得誇大，同樣的細菌引起更明顯的紅腫。
a.en: Pregnancy hormones exaggerate the gums' response to plaque bacteria, so the same bacteria cause more redness and swelling.

q.zh-Hant: 為什麼蛀牙最好在寶寶出生前處理，而不是等生完？
q.en: Why treat cavities before the baby is born rather than after?

a.zh-Hant: 拖延可能讓問題更複雜；而且產後致蛀牙細菌可能透過親吻等方式傳給寶寶，媽媽有很多未治療蛀牙時，孩子將來蛀牙的風險約高 3 倍。
a.en: Delay can make problems more complex, and after birth cavity-causing bacteria can pass to the baby through things like kisses; when a mother has many untreated cavities, the child's future cavity risk is about 3 times higher.

q.zh-Hant: 孕吐之後，怎麼保護牙齒？
q.en: After vomiting, how do you protect your teeth?

a.zh-Hant: 不要馬上刷牙，先用 1 杯水加 1 茶匙小蘇打漱口。
a.en: Don't brush right away; rinse first with 1 teaspoon of baking soda in a cup of water.

q.zh-Hant: 治療牙周病已經證明能預防早產嗎？
q.en: Has treating gum disease been proven to prevent preterm birth?

a.zh-Hant: 還沒有。2022 年合併 12 個試驗的分析發現，深層清潔整體上沒有顯著降低早產；看牙是為了你自己的口腔和寶寶將來的牙齒。
a.en: Not yet. A 2022 analysis of 12 trials found deep cleaning didn't significantly lower preterm birth overall; the reason to go is your own mouth and your baby's future teeth.
